correctness.rationale: All 60 distinct [5,3]_7 Reed--Solomon row spaces are reconstructed exactly over F_7. Pairwise intersection dimensions are obtained by exact modular row reduction. A displayed 10-clique gives the lower bound, exhaustive Bron--Kerbosch enumeration of every maximal clique gives maximum size 10, and a separate exact coloring-bound branch-and-bound search independently returns 10. The claim is restricted to this finite instance.
